newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid bourse ends flat, seen heading for new high.
newsitem.headline: Madrid bourse ends flat, seen heading for new high.

text.p: The Madrid bourse closed virtually unchanged on Thursday as stocks consolidated recent strong gains before heading for new highs, dealers said. * General index rose 1.96 points, 0.33 percent, 603.69. * Ibex-35 index gained 21.34 points, 0.31 pct, to 6,934.51. * Turnover reached 109 billion pesetas, with more than a quarter attributed to trade in Telefonica and Endesa. * Endesa outperformed the market, rising 2.54 pct to 12,100, while Iberdrola and Fecsa slipped by more than one percent.
"The market is still strong, there was some modest profit taking, but the trend remains good and we will go on to reach new historic highs," said one dealer.
